answer: The trellis schedule is applied in lotus and wander shows each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 42% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3921 identities would post 3415 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
